cited_revision_policy.external_url_policy: External URL quotes are checked only against a citation-time archive listed in probes/CNF-0164/archives/index.json; otherwise NOT-CHECKED. Live network fetch is never used as a substitute archive.
cited_revision_policy.method: EOL-normalise then classify against worktree bytes at the cited path. This worktree is not a git repository and command-center/receipts/CNF-0163.json is absent, so cited-revision cat-file is NOT-CHECKED rather than pretended.

extensions.question: Question: is every quoted snippet in the corpus a real quote, or a paraphrase presented as one? Compare each quoted span against the source at the cited revision after EOL normalisation, and classify as exact, whitespace-different, paraphrase, or absent. A paraphrase presented as a quote is an evidence defect even when its meaning is correct.
extensions.title: Quote-fidelity check: quoted source text must byte-match the source at that revision

retry.policy: Two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative implementations before a 3rd attempt. Schema $ref network fetch is not a classifier fingerprint; this emit uses platform/lib/schema_resolver.py.
